cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是英国广播公司国际台的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: Hello, I'm Oliver Conway.
cues.zh: 大家好，我是奥利弗·康韦。

cues.en: This edition is published in the early hours of Saturday, the 15th of August.
cues.zh: 本期节目于8月15日星期六凌晨发布。

cues.en: High-profile murder suspect Luigi Mangione admits killing a healthcare boss in New York.
cues.zh: 备受关注的谋杀案嫌疑人路易吉·曼吉奥内承认在纽约杀害一名医疗保险公司高管。

cues.en: Jason Arday, the Cambridge professor who resigned over accusations of plagiarism, is found dead.
cues.zh: 因被指抄袭而辞职的剑桥大学教授杰森·阿戴被发现死亡。

cues.en: And President Trump says he will soon declare the Strait of Hormuz a US territory.
cues.zh: 特朗普总统还说，他很快会宣布霍尔木兹海峡为美国领土。

cues.en: Also in this podcast: People drive around at 150 km/h, even though the speed limit on most roads is 90,
cues.zh: 本期节目还将报道：人们开车时速达到150公里，尽管大多数道路限速90公里，

cues.en: because it's believed that driving that fast can reduce the probability of a drone hitting your car.
cues.zh: 因为据说开得这么快能降低汽车被无人机击中的概率。

cues.en: How the war against Ukraine is affecting daily life in Russia.
cues.zh: 对乌克兰的战争如何影响俄罗斯人的日常生活。

cues.en: And Jeff Bezos buys a stake in English football.
cues.zh: 以及杰夫·贝索斯入股英格兰足球。

cues.en: But first, to a case that has gripped America: Health insurance boss Brian Thompson was shot dead outside a hotel in Manhattan in December 2024.
cues.zh: 但首先来看一起牵动全美的案件：2024年12月，医疗保险公司高管布赖恩·汤普森在曼哈顿一家酒店外遭枪击身亡。

cues.en: Now, the high-profile suspect, Luigi Mangione, has confessed to the killing in a New York court.
cues.zh: 如今，备受关注的嫌疑人路易吉·曼吉奥内已在纽约一家法院承认杀人。

cues.en: The case has divided opinion in the US, highlighting the anger some Americans feel about the trillion-dollar healthcare industry.
cues.zh: 此案令美国舆论分化，也凸显出部分美国人对规模达万亿美元的医疗产业所怀有的愤怒。

cues.en: Some called Mangione a hero who took a stand.
cues.zh: 有人称曼吉奥内是挺身而出的英雄。

cues.en: This was how his lawyer, Karen Friedman Agnifilo, defended his actions outside the court.
cues.zh: 他的律师凯伦·弗里德曼·阿尼菲洛在法院外这样为他的行为辩护。

cues.en: As Luigi explained in court today, he endured years of severe, debilitating pain following a broken back, while struggling to navigate our healthcare and health insurance systems.
cues.zh: 正如路易吉今天在法庭上所解释的那样，他背部骨折后多年忍受着严重、使人失去生活能力的疼痛，同时艰难应对我们的医疗和健康保险体系。

cues.en: Like the thousands of people who've reached out since this tragedy to share their own experiences, he believed that the system had failed him and destroyed his life.
cues.zh: 自这场悲剧发生以来，已有数千人联系我们分享各自的经历；和他们一样，他认为这个体系辜负了他，毁掉了他的人生。

cues.en: For others, though, he is a criminal who stalked and murdered an innocent man.
cues.zh: 但在另一些人看来，他是一个跟踪并杀害无辜者的罪犯。

cues.en: This was New York Police Commissioner Jessica Tisch.
cues.zh: 这是纽约市警察局局长杰西卡·蒂施。

cues.en: To those who idolize Luigi Mangione, I say this: Violence is not a cause, murder is not a message, and a killer is certainly not a hero.
cues.zh: 我要对那些把路易吉·曼吉奥内奉为偶像的人说：暴力不是事业，谋杀不是宣言，杀人者更绝不是英雄。

cues.en: Our correspondent Nada Tawfik was in court in New York. She spoke to my colleague Charlotte Gallagher.
cues.zh: 本台记者娜达·陶菲克当时在纽约法庭内。她接受了我的同事夏洛特·加拉格尔的采访。

cues.en: I was a few rows back from where Luigi Mangione was seated, with a direct view of him as he entered that plea of guilty.
cues.zh: 我坐在路易吉·曼吉奥内座位后几排的位置，可以直接看到他作出有罪答辩时的情形。

cues.en: And the judge, after asking him a series of questions about whether he understood that he was waiving his right to a trial,
cues.zh: 法官先向他提出一连串问题，询问他是否明白自己正在放弃受审权，

cues.en: asking if he was competent to make this decision, and whether he understood that he could be facing life in prison,
cues.zh: 又询问他是否具备作出这一决定的能力，以及是否明白自己可能面临终身监禁，

cues.en: after he answered all those questions very calmly, she then asked him to describe in his own words why he was guilty.
cues.zh: 他非常平静地回答完所有问题后，法官让他用自己的话说明为何自己有罪。

cues.en: And that was some of the most dramatic moments of this hearing, because he began speaking, still seated in a tan prison uniform,
cues.zh: 这成为庭审中最具戏剧性的时刻之一，因为他仍穿着棕褐色囚服坐在那里，开始陈述，

cues.en: saying that he had killed Brian Thompson in Manhattan and that he had planned to do it. And he said, "I knew what I was doing."
cues.zh: 他说，自己在曼哈顿杀害了布赖恩·汤普森，而且是有预谋的。他还说：“我知道自己在做什么。”

cues.en: He described how, you know, after enduring years of back pain and navigating—trying to navigate—the insurance industry without any luck,
cues.zh: 他讲述了自己多年来忍受背痛，以及应付——试图应付——保险行业却处处碰壁的经历，

cues.en: that he began researching and planning to go to this UnitedHealthcare annual investor conference,
cues.zh: 之后他开始调查，并计划前往联合健康集团的这场年度投资者大会，

cues.en: that he used a 3D printer to make a gun,
cues.zh: 他使用3D打印机制作了一把枪，

cues.en: and that he had the full intent to go there and to kill Mr Thompson, a father of two.
cues.zh: 而且他去那里的明确意图就是杀害身为两个孩子父亲的汤普森先生。

cues.en: So to hear Luigi Mangione set it out in that way in court, with Mr Thompson's family right there, emotional and listening to this, was quite a moment in court.
cues.zh: 汤普森先生的家人就在现场，情绪激动地听着这一切；听到路易吉·曼吉奥内在法庭上这样陈述，确实是庭上令人震动的一刻。

cues.en: You know, the judge then made sure he understood that she would decide on December 18th, during sentencing, how long he would spend in prison.
cues.zh: 法官随后确认他明白，她将在12月18日量刑时决定他的服刑年限。

cues.en: We already know from prosecutors that they plan to seek life in prison.
cues.zh: 我们已经从检方得知，他们计划寻求判处终身监禁。

cues.en: The defense are hoping that he gets less than that.
cues.zh: 辩方则希望他的刑期低于终身监禁。

cues.en: But this was really, of course, a dramatic moment in this legal process, because it's not just this federal case;
cues.zh: 但这无疑是这一法律程序中极具戏剧性的时刻，因为受到影响的不只是这起联邦案件；

cues.en: this now impacts the state trial that was due to begin in just a few weeks, on September 8th.
cues.zh: 这也会影响原定仅数周后、即9月8日开始的州级审判。

cues.en: The reaction to this case has been really polarizing, with some believing Mangione is a folk hero, almost.
cues.zh: 人们对此案的反应高度两极化，有些人几乎把曼吉奥内视为民间英雄。

cues.en: Does it underline how unhappy people are in the US with corporations?
cues.zh: 这是否凸显了美国民众对企业的不满程度？

cues.en: Look, I think any American you speak to can share their own stories of frustrations with the healthcare industry.
cues.zh: 你问任何一个美国人，我想他们都能讲出自己对医疗行业感到受挫的亲身经历。

cues.en: It is a very difficult system to navigate, very expensive.
cues.zh: 这个体系很难应付，而且费用高昂。

cues.en: So nobody denies that it is a system that needs reform.
cues.zh: 所以没有人否认这个体系需要改革。

cues.en: And I think this does underline just how much people's sense of inequality...
cues.zh: 我认为，这确实凸显了人们多么强烈的不平等感……

cues.en: You know, people often talk about how they feel corporate interests are trumping those of ordinary people in today's society.
cues.zh: 人们经常谈到，他们觉得在当今社会，企业利益正压过普通人的利益。

cues.en: I think all of this is certainly something that plays into why there's this surprising level of public support for Luigi Mangione.
cues.zh: 我认为，这一切无疑都有助于解释，为何路易吉·曼吉奥内会获得如此出人意料的公众支持。

cues.en: And what we've seen, and we heard there with the clips you played, is this attempt by public officials to reiterate that that does not justify murder.
cues.zh: 我们所看到的，以及刚才你播放的片段所反映的，是公职人员试图重申：这些不满并不能成为谋杀的正当理由。

cues.en: That, at the end of the day, Luigi Mangione—and he has pleaded guilty to that today—has taken the life of a father of two, a CEO,
cues.zh: 归根结底，路易吉·曼吉奥内——他今天已经就此认罪——夺走了一名公司首席执行官、两个孩子父亲的生命，

cues.en: in a brazen killing in New York, and that that shouldn't—he should not be justified as, you know, a modern-day vigilante taking justice into his own hands.
cues.zh: 这是发生在纽约的一起公然杀人案；不应把他正当化为一个自行执法的现代义警。

cues.en: Nada Tawfik in New York.
cues.zh: 娜达·陶菲克在纽约报道。

cues.en: He was at the heart of a culture war in Britain.
cues.zh: 他曾处于英国一场文化之争的中心。

cues.en: Now he is dead.
cues.zh: 如今，他已经去世。

cues.en: The appointment of Jason Arday as the youngest ever Black professor at Cambridge University in 2023 was celebrated at the time as a progressive moment.
cues.zh: 2023年，杰森·阿戴获任剑桥大学史上最年轻的黑人教授，当时被誉为一个具有进步意义的时刻。

cues.en: I was diagnosed with autism at the age of three.
cues.zh: 我三岁时被诊断患有自闭症。

cues.en: I learned to speak just before the age of 12, so I was 11.
cues.zh: 我快满12岁时才学会说话，也就是当时11岁。

cues.en: I learned to read and write when I was 18 years of age.
cues.zh: 我18岁时才学会读写。

cues.en: Those milestones became quite significant.
cues.zh: 这些人生节点变得相当重要。

cues.en: Twelve years after learning to read and write, I gained a PhD, and then I ended up becoming one of the youngest professorial chairs in Cambridge's history.
cues.zh: 学会读写12年后，我取得了博士学位，后来成为剑桥大学历史上最年轻的教授之一。

cues.en: Jason Arday, talking to the BBC three years ago after joining Cambridge at the age of 37.
cues.zh: 这是杰森·阿戴三年前、37岁加入剑桥大学后接受BBC采访时所说的话。

cues.en: But it all came crashing down last week when he resigned following allegations of plagiarism and doubts over some of the claims he'd made about his life.
cues.zh: 但上周，在受到抄袭指控、个人经历中的一些说法也遭到质疑后，他辞职了，一切骤然崩塌。

cues.en: He denied plagiarism, but admitted errors in his work, and stepped down after the university announced an investigation.
cues.zh: 他否认抄袭，但承认作品中存在错误，并在校方宣布展开调查后辞职。

cues.en: On Friday, Jason Arday was found dead at a home in London.
cues.zh: 星期五，杰森·阿戴被发现死于伦敦一处住宅。

cues.en: Police said his death was unexpected, but is not believed to be suspicious.
cues.zh: 警方称，他的死亡来得突然，但据信并无可疑之处。

cues.en: Professor Simon Baron-Cohen from Cambridge was in contact with him in the hours before he died.
cues.zh: 剑桥大学的西蒙·巴伦-科恩教授在他去世前数小时曾与他保持联系。

cues.en: He was being subjected by both social media and traditional media over the last few weeks,
cues.zh: 过去几周，他一直承受着社交媒体和传统媒体的压力，

cues.en: since the plagiarism allegations came to sort of national news and then international news.
cues.zh: 因为抄袭指控先后成为全国乃至国际新闻。

cues.en: He was being subjected on an hourly basis to ridicule, humiliation.
cues.zh: 他几乎每小时都在遭受嘲弄和羞辱。

cues.en: He told me this morning that he couldn't leave his home because his face was now so well-known, his name was so well-known, that he was a figure of shame.
cues.zh: 他今天早上告诉我，他无法离开家，因为他的脸和名字如今都太为人熟知，他已经成了一个蒙羞的公众人物。

cues.en: Jason Arday's family have condemned what they called a campaign of harassment against him.
cues.zh: 杰森·阿戴的家人谴责了他们所称的针对他的骚扰行动。

cues.en: They said he'd been subjected to sustained abuse by people who would leave no stone unturned in their quest to undermine him.
cues.zh: 家人表示，有些人为了诋毁他不遗余力，使他长期遭受辱骂。

cues.en: Our correspondent Helena Wilkinson told us more about Jason Arday and the scrutiny he'd faced in recent weeks.
cues.zh: 本台记者海伦娜·威尔金森进一步介绍了杰森·阿戴及其近几周面临的审视。

cues.en: He appeared regularly in the media, speaking about a number of subjects, from his personal journey into academia to societal debates.
cues.zh: 他经常出现在媒体上，谈论从个人学术生涯到社会议题等多个主题。

cues.en: There were recent allegations of plagiarism and questions about some of his achievements.
cues.zh: 近期有人指控他抄袭，并对他的部分成就提出质疑。

cues.en: He denied those claims.
cues.zh: 他否认了这些说法。

cues.en: He did admit errors in his work, but he said he had faced an unrelenting level of public scrutiny and personal attack.
cues.zh: 他确实承认作品中存在错误，但表示自己遭受了无休止的公众审视和人身攻击。

cues.en: And he also said he was not a liar.
cues.zh: 他还表示，自己不是骗子。

cues.en: When he resigned from his post, he talked about that intense public scrutiny that was on him.
cues.zh: 辞去职务时，他谈到了自己承受的强烈公众审视。

cues.en: And he said in a statement: ‘The relentless accusations, speculation and public commentary have taken a profound toll on me and on those I love.’
cues.zh: 他在一份声明中说：“接连不断的指控、猜测和公众评论，给我和我所爱的人造成了深重影响。”

cues.en: And that is why, he said, he felt like he had to step back.
cues.zh: 他说，正因如此，他觉得自己不得不退下来。

cues.en: He stressed that his resignation should not be mistaken for an acceptance of ‘the narratives that have surrounded me’.
cues.zh: 他强调，不应把他的辞职误解为他接受了“围绕我的那些说法”。

cues.en: That is what he said in a statement.
cues.zh: 这是他在声明中的说法。

cues.en: Some critics have said the treatment of him had been motivated by racism, but others said the claims of plagiarism were legitimate.
cues.zh: 一些批评者认为，他所受的对待出于种族主义动机；但也有人认为，抄袭指控有正当依据。

cues.en: There will be a number of questions following the news that Jason Arday was found dead.
cues.zh: 杰森·阿戴被发现死亡的消息传出后，将会出现一系列疑问。

cues.en: Let me just bring you the statement from the Metropolitan Police, who said that they had been called to an address in South London.
cues.zh: 我来介绍一下伦敦警察厅的声明。警方称，他们接报前往伦敦南部一处地址。

cues.en: Emergency services found a man to be unresponsive, a 41-year-old man.
cues.zh: 急救人员发现一名41岁男子已无反应。

cues.en: At this time, they say his death is being treated as unexpected, but is not believed to be suspicious.
cues.zh: 警方表示，目前将其死亡视为突发事件，但据信并无可疑之处。

cues.en: But yes, there will be a huge number of questions now.
cues.zh: 不过，确实会有大量问题随之而来。

cues.en: There is that independent investigation that Cambridge University are carrying out, and Cambridge University Vice-Chancellor Professor Deborah Prentice has said:
cues.zh: 剑桥大学仍在进行独立调查。剑桥大学副校长德博拉·普伦蒂斯教授表示：

cues.en: ‘We are desperately saddened to hear this tragic news.’
cues.zh: “听到这一噩耗，我们深感悲痛。”

cues.en: ‘Our heartfelt sympathies go to Jason Arday's family and friends at this incredibly difficult time.’
cues.zh: “在这个极其艰难的时刻，我们向杰森·阿戴的家人和朋友致以最深切的慰问。”

cues.en: Helena Wilkinson.
cues.zh: 海伦娜·威尔金森报道。

cues.en: Peace talks between the US and Iran appear to be going nowhere at the moment, with the Strait of Hormuz remaining a key sticking point.
cues.zh: 美国与伊朗之间的和平谈判目前似乎毫无进展，霍尔木兹海峡仍是一个关键症结。

cues.en: But that hasn't stopped President Trump saying the waterway could soon come under American control.
cues.zh: 但这并未阻止特朗普总统声称，这条水道可能很快会受美国控制。

cues.en: And after we finish defeating Iran, which is being very badly defeated,
cues.zh: 等我们彻底击败伊朗——伊朗现在正遭到惨败——

cues.en: pretty soon I'll be declaring the Strait of Hormuz a territory of the United States.
cues.zh: 很快，我就会宣布霍尔木兹海峡为美国领土。

cues.en: But Iran's Deputy Foreign Minister responded by saying the strait would remain under Iranian authority.
cues.zh: 但伊朗副外长回应称，该海峡仍将由伊朗管辖。

cues.en: Its closure has already had a big impact on US petrol prices, but President Trump said Americans should accept paying a tiny bit more for gas.
cues.zh: 海峡关闭已对美国汽油价格产生重大影响，但特朗普总统说，美国人应接受为汽油多付一点点钱。

cues.en: I heard more about that from Daniel Bush in Washington. But first, he gave me his assessment of Mr Trump's claim that the Strait of Hormuz could become US territory.
cues.zh: 丹尼尔·布什在华盛顿向我作了进一步介绍。但首先，他评估了特朗普关于霍尔木兹海峡可能成为美国领土的说法。

cues.en: This is a President who likes to throw out lines like this at political rallies.
cues.zh: 这位总统喜欢在政治集会上抛出这样的说法。

cues.en: Of course, there is no sort of concrete policy behind this.
cues.zh: 当然，这背后并没有任何具体政策。

cues.en: It's unclear how the United States would even go about doing that.
cues.zh: 甚至连美国会如何实施都不清楚。

cues.en: The Strait of Hormuz is an international waterway that's controlled partly by multiple different countries in the region.
cues.zh: 霍尔木兹海峡是一条国际水道，其部分区域由该地区多个不同国家管辖。

cues.en: So how the US would even do that remains unclear.
cues.zh: 因此，美国究竟要如何做到这一点仍不清楚。

cues.en: And of course, before all of that, there is still this war that the US has not won.
cues.zh: 当然，在这一切之前，这场美国尚未取胜的战争仍在继续。

cues.en: President Trump is struggling to figure out how to get Tehran back to the negotiating table.
cues.zh: 特朗普总统正设法弄清如何让德黑兰重返谈判桌。

cues.en: There is a naval blockade which is still in place there.
cues.zh: 当地的海上封锁仍未解除。

cues.en: There is no end in sight to this war.
cues.zh: 这场战争仍看不到尽头。

cues.en: So this is a President, you know, speaking about a moment that could be months from now, without a lot of sort of concrete policy behind how it is that he might do that.
cues.zh: 所以，你知道，这位总统谈论的是一个可能要几个月后才会到来的时刻，而对于他可能如何实现这一点，并没有多少具体政策支撑。

cues.en: And this is in the context of a political rally, where President Trump often likes to throw out these kinds of lines to test them, if you will, with his base.
cues.zh: 而且这番话是在政治集会的语境中说的；特朗普总统常喜欢抛出这类说法，可以说是拿他的基本盘来测试反应。

cues.en: He does this to see if they're popular, to see if they'll get applause lines.
cues.zh: 他这样做，是为了看看这些说法是否受欢迎、能否赢得掌声。

cues.en: It's also not the first time that President Trump has made some of these claims with the war in Iran, and specifically around the strait.
cues.zh: 这也不是特朗普总统第一次就伊朗战争，尤其是围绕该海峡，提出这类主张。

cues.en: A couple of months ago, he said that he might consider naming the Strait of Hormuz the Strait of America.
cues.zh: 几个月前，他说自己可能会考虑把霍尔木兹海峡改称“美利坚海峡”。

cues.en: Months later, that has not been the case.
cues.zh: 几个月过去，这并未成为现实。

cues.en: One of the other lines he threw out was, “Americans will have to pay a tiny little bit more for gasoline to stop Iran getting a nuclear weapon.”
cues.zh: 他抛出的另一个说法是：“为了阻止伊朗获得核武器，美国人将不得不为汽油多付一点点钱。”

cues.en: How will that go down among his base and the wider American public?
cues.zh: 他的基本盘和更广泛的美国公众会如何看待这番话？

cues.en: Not so well. Gas prices have been high for months now as a result of this war.
cues.zh: 反响不会太好。受这场战争影响，汽油价格已经连续数月居高不下。

cues.en: And President Trump, on multiple occasions, has said very explicitly that he's not very concerned about that.
cues.zh: 特朗普总统已多次非常明确地表示，他对此并不太担心。

cues.en: He's not concerned about the midterms, that he's not taking those things into his calculations when he decides how to go about this war with Iran.
cues.zh: 他不担心中期选举；在决定如何处理这场与伊朗的战争时，他没有把这些因素纳入考量。

cues.en: So that's something else that he and other senior administration officials have said multiple times:
cues.zh: 所以，他和其他政府高级官员还多次表示：

cues.en: that, you know, American consumers will pay a slightly higher price for gas now.
cues.zh: 美国消费者现在会为汽油支付稍高一些的价格。

cues.en: But that in the long run, it'll be worth it
cues.zh: 但从长远来看，这样做是值得的，

cues.en: because of the, you know, the safety for Americans and the national security improvements for the region and for US allies in the Middle East.
cues.zh: 因为这关系到美国人的安全，以及改善该地区和美国中东盟友的国家安全。

cues.en: But Republicans, Olly, in the United States here, who are very focused on their re-election prospects, have not liked this rhetoric.
cues.zh: 但是，奥利，美国这里那些非常关注自己连任前景的共和党人并不喜欢这种说法。

cues.en: You know, prices at the gas pump are first and foremost, you know, a top concern for voters.
cues.zh: 你知道，加油站的油价首先就是选民最关心的问题之一。

cues.en: And so Republicans would like to see President Trump's rhetoric shift on this.
cues.zh: 因此，共和党人希望看到特朗普总统改变在这个问题上的措辞。

cues.en: They would like to see him acknowledge a little bit more the economic sacrifices that the country is making for this war effort.
cues.zh: 他们希望他更多承认，这个国家正为战争行动付出经济代价。

cues.en: But with a couple of months left, President Trump seems to be continuing with this messaging that this is just a short-term pain that Americans are going to have to endure.
cues.zh: 但在只剩几个月的情况下，特朗普总统似乎仍在延续这种说法：这只是美国人不得不承受的短期阵痛。

cues.en: Daniel Bush in Washington.
cues.zh: 丹尼尔·布什在华盛顿报道。

cues.en: The founder of Amazon, Jeff Bezos, has bought a share of the Premier League football club Liverpool as part of a consortium.
cues.zh: 亚马逊创始人杰夫·贝索斯作为一家财团的成员，买下了英超足球俱乐部利物浦的部分股份。

cues.en: He's the latest American billionaire to invest in English football, despite the sport not being that popular in the US.
cues.zh: 尽管足球在美国没有那么受欢迎，他仍成为最新一位投资英格兰足球的美国亿万富翁。

cues.en: Jane Dougall has the details.
cues.zh: 简·杜格尔介绍详细情况。

cues.en: We have confirmation from Fenway Sports Group that they have agreed to sell around a third of the club to this consortium, which includes the billionaire Amazon founder Jeff Bezos.
cues.zh: 芬威体育集团已证实，他们同意将俱乐部约三分之一的股份出售给这家财团；财团成员包括亚马逊创始人、亿万富翁杰夫·贝索斯。

cues.en: Now, Fenway said in a statement they'd entered into a definitive agreement, and that the deal supports Liverpool's long-term growth ambitions,
cues.zh: 芬威在一份声明中表示，双方已达成最终协议，这笔交易将支持利物浦的长期增长目标；

cues.en: but that FSG will retain majority ownership and operational control of Liverpool,
cues.zh: 不过，FSG仍将保留利物浦的多数股权和运营控制权；

cues.en: although it is suspected that this could be the catalyst for the American owners to gradually step away after 16 years in charge.
cues.zh: 但有人猜测，这可能成为美国老板在掌管俱乐部16年后逐步退出的催化剂。

cues.en: But let's take a look at the consortium itself.
cues.zh: 不过，我们来看看这家财团本身。

cues.en: It's led by British-Indian millionaire businessman Amit Bhatia, and also includes the billionaire Facebook co-owner Eduardo Saverin.
cues.zh: 财团由英籍印度裔百万富翁商人阿米特·巴蒂亚领衔，成员还包括Facebook共同所有人、亿万富翁爱德华多·萨维林。

cues.en: But it's Bhatia who's going to be the football brains of this consortium.
cues.zh: 不过，巴蒂亚将是这家财团中负责足球事务的智囊。

cues.en: Let's not kid ourselves, though, here. Bezos is not investing because he grew up watching Kenny Dalglish.
cues.zh: 但我们不要自欺欺人。贝索斯投资并不是因为他从小看肯尼·达格利什踢球。

cues.en: He is investing because they're looking for a return.
cues.zh: 他之所以投资，是因为财团希望获得回报。

cues.en: Liverpool is said to be valued at £5–6 billion.
cues.zh: 据称，利物浦的估值为50亿至60亿英镑。

cues.en: They recorded £703 million in revenue in their title-winning season, 2024–25.
cues.zh: 在2024至2025赛季夺冠期间，利物浦录得7.03亿英镑收入。

cues.en: They've got a global audience of 200 million followers across all social media platforms.
cues.zh: 利物浦在各个社交媒体平台上的全球粉丝总数达到2亿。

cues.en: Let's put that into perspective for an American investor like Bezos.
cues.zh: 我们从贝索斯这样的美国投资者角度比较一下这些数字。

cues.en: The LA Lakers, the NBA franchise that's expected to be purchased by Josh Kushner and Bob Iger—the Lakers look set to be purchased for a reported 9.3 billion,
cues.zh: NBA球队洛杉矶湖人预计将由乔希·库什纳和鲍勃·艾格尔收购；据报道，收购价将达到93亿，

cues.en: twice the amount that Liverpool is said to be worth.
cues.zh: 是利物浦据称估值的两倍。

cues.en: And the NBA team generated around £407 million, half of what Liverpool generated.
cues.zh: 而这支NBA球队的收入约为4.07亿英镑，只有利物浦的一半。

cues.en: So you can see the attraction, can't you?
cues.zh: 所以你能看出其中的吸引力，对吧？

cues.en: And also, there are 26 million supporters in the US.
cues.zh: 此外，利物浦在美国有2600万名支持者。

cues.en: They have the fastest-growing fan base of any Premier League club in the country.
cues.zh: 在美国所有英超俱乐部中，利物浦的球迷群体增长速度最快。

cues.en: Jane Dougall.
cues.zh: 简·杜格尔。

cues.en: And still to come on the podcast: I think men fancy themselves that they can do anything.
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后还将报道：我认为，男人总觉得自己无所不能。

cues.en: There is this confidence that I see in a lot of men, which just means that they think that everything is easy and that they can just do it.
cues.zh: 我在许多男性身上看到这种自信；这意味着他们觉得一切都很容易，自己说做就能做到。

cues.en: Why two in five men think they'd be good enough to compete at the next Olympics.
cues.zh: 为何五分之二的男性认为自己有足够实力参加下一届奥运会。

cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: As Russia continues to bombard Ukraine, Kyiv is responding with its own campaign of long-range strikes.
cues.zh: 随着俄罗斯继续轰炸乌克兰，基辅也以自己的远程打击行动作出回应。

cues.en: Ukrainians have had more than four years of this, but for many Russians, the war now feels closer than ever before.
cues.zh: 乌克兰人已经承受这种局面四年多，但对许多俄罗斯人来说，战争如今也比以往任何时候都更近。

cues.en: Our correspondent James Beardsworth has been speaking to people across Russia.
cues.zh: 本台记者詹姆斯·比尔兹沃思采访了俄罗斯各地的居民。

cues.en: Their names have been changed to protect their safety.
cues.zh: 为保护他们的安全，报道中使用了化名。

cues.en: In the city of Elektrostal, 60 kilometres east of Moscow, a Ukrainian drone crashes into a warehouse of the Russian retailer Wildberries.
cues.zh: 在莫斯科以东60公里的埃列克特罗斯塔尔市，一架乌克兰无人机撞入俄罗斯零售商Wildberries的一座仓库。

cues.en: The explosions and resulting fires, which burned for three days and were so large they could be seen from space, destroyed tens of millions of dollars' worth of goods.
cues.zh: 爆炸引发的大火燃烧了三天，规模之大从太空都能看到，并烧毁了价值数千万美元的商品。

cues.en: The warehouse burned down, and we were told that all of our products, everything we had stored there, was lost.
cues.zh: 仓库被烧毁了，我们被告知，所有产品、所有存放在那里的货物都没了。

cues.en: Margarita owns a small business selling confectionery across Russia.
cues.zh: 玛格丽塔经营一家面向俄罗斯各地销售糖果的小企业。

cues.en: The strikes on the Elektrostal plant cost her business thousands of dollars.
cues.zh: 对埃列克特罗斯塔尔设施的打击让她的企业损失了数千美元。

cues.en: Wildberries became one of our main sales channels.
cues.zh: Wildberries已经成为我们的主要销售渠道之一。

cues.en: There, our sweets can be shipped to different cities across Russia and to neighbouring countries.
cues.zh: 通过这个平台，我们的糖果可以运往俄罗斯各地城市和邻国。

cues.en: But now we need to change our approach due to recent events.
cues.zh: 但由于近期发生的事件，我们现在必须调整经营方式。

cues.en: The strikes on the retailer, Russia's equivalent of Amazon,
cues.zh: 这家被称为“俄罗斯版亚马逊”的零售商遭到打击，

cues.en: are part of a recent Ukrainian campaign of long-range drone strikes targeting critical infrastructure deep inside Russia.
cues.zh: 是乌克兰近期远程无人机行动的一部分；该行动瞄准俄罗斯腹地的关键基础设施。

cues.en: A plan, President Zelenskyy says, that is aimed at ‘bringing the war back to Russia’.
cues.zh: 泽连斯基总统表示，这项计划旨在“把战争带回俄罗斯”。

cues.en: Often thousands of kilometres from the front lines, the drone attacks have disrupted daily life.
cues.zh: 这些无人机袭击往往发生在距离前线数千公里的地方，扰乱了日常生活。

cues.en: They also remind Russians of a war that Moscow launched over four years ago.
cues.zh: 这些袭击也提醒俄罗斯人，这场战争是莫斯科在四年多前发动的。

cues.en: Polina is a teacher in Moscow.
cues.zh: 波琳娜是莫斯科的一名教师。

cues.en: Now that we know that a drone can hit our apartments, we feel scared for us, for our lives, for our relatives.
cues.zh: 如今我们知道无人机可能击中自己的公寓，所以会担心自己、自己的生命和亲人的安全。

cues.en: You know, and we feel that the war is closer than ever.
cues.zh: 你知道，我们觉得战争比以往任何时候都更近。

cues.en: These strikes are much less frequent than Russia's daily drone and missile attacks across Ukraine.
cues.zh: 这些打击的频率远低于俄罗斯每天对乌克兰各地发动的无人机和导弹袭击。

cues.en: In Ukraine, however, civilian deaths in July were at their highest since the first few months of the war.
cues.zh: 然而，乌克兰7月的平民死亡人数已升至战争最初几个月以来的最高水平。

cues.en: Polina said the situation in the Russian capital is becoming more and more difficult.
cues.zh: 波琳娜表示，俄罗斯首都的处境正变得越来越困难。

cues.en: In Russia's Kursk region, closer to the Ukrainian border, the situation is far more perilous.
cues.zh: 在更靠近乌克兰边境的俄罗斯库尔斯克地区，情况要危险得多。

cues.en: People drive around at 150 kilometres per hour, even though the speed limit on most roads is 90.
cues.zh: 当地人会以每小时150公里的速度驾车，尽管大多数道路的限速是每小时90公里。

cues.en: This is because it's believed that driving that fast can reduce the probability of a drone hitting your car.
cues.zh: 这是因为人们相信，开得这么快可以降低汽车被无人机击中的概率。

cues.en: Nikolai is a Kursk resident and lives just an hour's drive away from the Russia-Ukraine border.
cues.zh: 尼古拉是库尔斯克居民，住处距离俄乌边境只有约一小时车程。

cues.en: There, communications are heavily restricted, he says, and until recently, getting fuel had become a real struggle.
cues.zh: 他表示，当地通信受到严格限制，而且直到最近，加油都非常困难。

cues.en: I stood in line for two hours to get fuel.
cues.zh: 我排了两个小时的队才加到油。

cues.en: There were also limits on how much you could get.
cues.zh: 加油量也受到限制。

cues.en: Then later, they introduced a different restriction based on licence plate numbers.
cues.zh: 后来，当地又根据车牌号码实施了另一种限制。

cues.en: If your plate ends in an even number, you can fill up on even-numbered days.
cues.zh: 如果车牌尾号是偶数，就可以在偶数日期加油。

cues.en: Odd number, then on odd-numbered days.
cues.zh: 尾号是奇数，则在奇数日期加油。

cues.en: Ukrainian drones have struck nearly all of Russia's major oil refineries, sparking a fuel crisis across the country.
cues.zh: 乌克兰无人机已经袭击俄罗斯几乎所有主要炼油厂，在全国引发燃油危机。

cues.en: The attacks have also led to price rises, Polina says.
cues.zh: 波琳娜表示，这些袭击还导致了物价上涨。

cues.en: Everything is becoming more and more expensive, so people have to save money.
cues.zh: 所有东西都越来越贵，人们不得不省钱。

cues.en: People I know, they used to travel abroad, but now they go somewhere like Krasnodarsky Krai, for example, because they don't have money.
cues.zh: 我认识的人过去会出国旅行，但现在因为没钱，只能去克拉斯诺达尔边疆区之类的地方。

cues.en: Travel, too, has become more problematic.
cues.zh: 出行也变得更加麻烦。

cues.en: Mira, a St Petersburg resident, remembers a trip she took to the southern Russian city of Sochi late last year.
cues.zh: 圣彼得堡居民米拉回忆起去年年底前往俄罗斯南部城市索契的一次旅行。

cues.en: Due to the drones, the situation in the air wasn't safe.
cues.zh: 由于有无人机活动，当时的空中状况并不安全。

cues.en: So in the end, I spent a sleepless night at the airport waiting for another flight to Sochi.
cues.zh: 所以最后，我在机场彻夜未眠，等待另一班飞往索契的航班。

cues.en: Basically, this is our reality now.
cues.zh: 基本上，这就是我们如今的现实。

cues.en: But rather than point fingers, the people I spoke to said that most are quietly adjusting to what is quickly becoming a new reality.
cues.zh: 不过，我采访的人没有相互指责，而是说，大多数人正在默默适应这个迅速形成的新现实。

cues.en: Nikolai again.
cues.zh: 再来听尼古拉。

cues.en: People have already gotten used to things.
cues.zh: 人们已经习惯了这些事情。

cues.en: At this point, nothing can really surprise them.
cues.zh: 到了这个时候，已经没有什么能真正让他们感到惊讶。

cues.en: A sentiment also shared by Mira.
cues.zh: 米拉也有同样的感受。

cues.en: Everyone knows what's causing the issue, and everyone knows that it's not going to end tomorrow.
cues.zh: 大家都知道问题的起因，也知道这一切不会明天就结束。

cues.en: So I think we've reached a certain stage of acceptance.
cues.zh: 所以我认为，我们已经到达了某种接受现实的阶段。

cues.en: First is denial, then anger, then depression.
cues.zh: 先是否认，然后是愤怒，接着是抑郁。

cues.en: Well, I think we've reached the depression stage.
cues.zh: 嗯，我认为我们已经到了抑郁阶段。

cues.en: That report by James Beardsworth.
cues.zh: 以上是詹姆斯·比尔兹沃思的报道。

cues.en: Following the surge of migrants to the Spanish North African territory of Ceuta,
cues.zh: 在移民大量涌入西班牙北非属地休达之后，

cues.en: the BBC has identified dozens of Instagram profiles promoting positive content about crossing there from Morocco.
cues.zh: BBC发现了数十个Instagram账号，它们发布美化从摩洛哥越境前往休达的内容。

cues.en: Some of them offer assistance to migrants in exchange for a fee and suggest further attempts will be made this weekend.
cues.zh: 其中一些账号收费向移民提供协助，并暗示本周末还会有人尝试越境。

cues.en: Our disinformation correspondent Marianna Spring has been investigating.
cues.zh: 本台虚假信息事务记者玛丽安娜·斯普林对此展开了调查。

cues.en: Mohamed wants to travel from Morocco to the neighbouring Spanish territory of Ceuta, on the northern tip of Africa.
cues.zh: 穆罕默德想从摩洛哥前往邻近的西班牙属地休达，那里位于非洲北端。

cues.en: He's a Moroccan man in his twenties and wants to emigrate to Europe, not least because he's been seeing lots of videos on Instagram that make the trip look easy.
cues.zh: 他是一名二十多岁的摩洛哥男子，想移民欧洲，一个重要原因是他在 Instagram 上看到大量把这段旅程描述得很轻松的视频。

cues.en: He's contacted several of the Instagram accounts, and one replies, claiming to have helped many people and offering him advice on how to cross for hundreds of pounds.
cues.zh: 他联系了多个 Instagram 账号，其中一个回复称自己帮助过很多人，并提出收取数百英镑，为他提供如何越境的建议。

cues.en: Except Mohamed isn't real.
cues.zh: 但穆罕默德并非真人。

cues.en: He's a dummy account the BBC set up to investigate a network of interconnected Instagram profiles that are helping to drive the influx of migrants to Ceuta.
cues.zh: 这是BBC为调查一个相互关联的Instagram账号网络而设立的虚拟账号；该网络正在助推移民涌入休达。

cues.en: Last month, roughly 78,000 people crossed from Morocco by sea into Ceuta in a matter of hours, scores of whom died in the attempt.
cues.zh: 上个月，约有 7.8 万人在数小时内从摩洛哥渡海进入休达，其中数十人在尝试过程中丧生。

cues.en: The crisis has calmed since, but it sparked tensions between EU nations who share open borders.
cues.zh: 此后危机已经缓和，但它引发了实行开放边界的欧盟国家之间的紧张关系。

cues.en: There's also been criticism of the Spanish government.
cues.zh: 西班牙政府也受到批评。

cues.en: The BBC's Top Comment podcast has identified dozens of Instagram profiles that portray the short swim around the Morocco-Ceuta border fence as safe and easy.
cues.zh: BBC 的《Top Comment》播客发现了数十个 Instagram 账号，它们把绕过摩洛哥与休达边境围栏的短途游泳描述得既安全又容易。

cues.en: The accounts also wrongly portray Ceuta as a viable route to mainland Europe.
cues.zh: 这些账号还错误地把休达描述成一条通往欧洲大陆的可行路线。

cues.en: The BBC's research suggests these accounts have contributed to the influx alongside other factors,
cues.zh: BBC的研究显示，这些账号与其他因素一道助推了移民涌入，

cues.en: such as misinformation about changes to Spanish immigration law and allegations about weak border controls.
cues.zh: 例如有关西班牙移民法变更的虚假信息，以及对边境管控薄弱的指称。

cues.en: Meta, which owns Instagram, told the BBC that it removes content that violates its policies, including content that offers to provide, facilitate or seek human smuggling services.
cues.zh: Instagram 的母公司 Meta 告诉 BBC，它会删除违反其政策的内容，包括提供、协助或寻求人口走私服务的内容。

cues.en: Marianna Spring.
cues.zh: 玛丽安娜·斯普林报道。

cues.en: We end this podcast with a question about sporting prowess from our reporter Stephanie Prentice.
cues.zh: 节目最后，本台记者斯蒂芬妮·普伦蒂斯带来一个有关运动能力的问题。

cues.en: Olly, so tell me, if you started training with a professional coach tomorrow morning, could you compete in the 2028 Olympics in Los Angeles?
cues.zh: 奥利，告诉我，如果你从明天早上开始接受职业教练训练，你能参加 2028 年洛杉矶奥运会吗？

cues.en: I don't think I could.
cues.zh: 我觉得我做不到。

cues.en: I'm not a big fan of athletics.
cues.zh: 我不太喜欢田径。

cues.en: I'm not very good at running or long jump or any of those things.
cues.zh: 我不太擅长跑步、跳远之类的项目。

cues.en: My sport is football, but even there, I think I'd struggle to match the professionals.
cues.zh: 我擅长的运动是足球，但即便在这方面，我觉得自己也很难达到职业选手的水平。

cues.en: Why are you asking? Well, there is a reason for this.
cues.zh: 你为什么这么问？嗯，这么问是有原因的。

cues.en: So, a new piece of research, it surveyed 2,000 people in the UK, and it found:
cues.zh: 一项新研究调查了英国 2,000 人，结果发现：

cues.en: Almost 40% of men thought they could compete in the next Olympics if they had professional training and a strict regime.
cues.zh: 近 40% 的男性认为，只要接受专业训练和严格的训练安排，他们就能参加下一届奥运会。

cues.en: More than a quarter of those men also said they could not only compete, but they could beat a professional in their chosen sport if they tried.
cues.zh: 这些男性中超过四分之一还表示，只要努力，他们不仅能参赛，还能在自己选择的项目中击败职业选手。

cues.en: Not unlike you, a lot of them selected football as an area they could shine.
cues.zh: 和你差不多，许多人选择了足球，认为自己能在这个项目上大显身手。

cues.en: That was followed by tennis, so, so far so British, and 12% of them backed themselves to do the 100-metre sprint in under 15 seconds.
cues.zh: 其次是网球——到这里都很有英国特色——另有 12% 的人相信自己能在 15 秒内跑完 100 米。

cues.en: Now, people were more cautious on thriving in sports like gymnastics and diving.
cues.zh: 对于体操和跳水等项目，人们就谨慎得多。

cues.en: But overall, a third of those asked said that confidence would be more important in achieving success than natural ability.
cues.zh: 但总体而言，三分之一的受访者表示，要取得成功，自信比天赋更重要。

cues.en: There is a related psychological term for this. It's the Dunning-Kruger effect.
cues.zh: 心理学中有一个与此相关的术语，叫作邓宁—克鲁格效应。

cues.en: It's basically a bias where people with low ability or knowledge kind of overestimate their competence.
cues.zh: 这基本上是一种认知偏差：能力或知识水平较低的人往往会高估自己的能力。

cues.en: So we put this to the test.
cues.zh: 所以我们对此进行了测试。

cues.en: We asked some people in and around the BBC whether they could make it to the next Olympics if they had that dedicated training.
cues.zh: 我们询问了 BBC 内外的一些人，如果接受这种全身心投入的训练，他们能否参加下一届奥运会。

cues.en: I think I could, yeah. Especially if someone, like you said, is a professional coach. I think I could, yeah.
cues.zh: 我觉得我可以。对，特别是如果像你说的，有专业教练来指导。我觉得我可以。

cues.en: What would you choose to compete in?
cues.zh: 你会选择参加什么项目？

cues.en: Probably 100 metres, 100 metres.
How quickly could you do the 100 metres, do you reckon, after all that training?
cues.zh: 你觉得，经过那么多训练后，自己能用多长时间跑完 100 米？

cues.en: Under 12, yeah, under 12 seconds.
cues.zh: 12 秒以内，对，12 秒以内。

cues.en: I always think that Olympians and sports people make it look easy. And so, no, I think it takes a lot longer than that to get good at something.
cues.zh: 我总觉得奥运选手和运动员把一切表现得很容易。所以不行，我认为要真正擅长一件事，需要的时间比那长得多。

cues.en: Well, of course, if I have time and if I have the right training, then probably yes, I can.
cues.zh: 嗯，当然，如果我有时间，又能接受合适的训练，那我大概可以。

cues.en: I think men fancy themselves that they can do anything.
cues.zh: 我觉得男人自认为无所不能。

cues.en: There's this confidence that I see in a lot of men, which just means that they think that everything is easy and that they can just do it.
cues.zh: 我在很多男人身上都看到这种自信，也就是说，他们觉得凡事都很容易，自己随手就能做到。

cues.en: Probably depends on the sport. I definitely couldn't beat a professional sprinter.
cues.zh: 可能要看是什么项目。我肯定赢不了职业短跑运动员。

cues.en: Anything that you back yourself in?
cues.zh: 有什么项目是你觉得自己能行的吗？

cues.en: 2028 Olympics in Los Angeles. Hot.
cues.zh: 2028 年洛杉矶奥运会。很热。

cues.en: Oh, I don't do well in the heat.
cues.zh: 哦，我在炎热天气里表现不好。

cues.en: So a mixture there, but as you mentioned, this is all about misplaced confidence.
cues.zh: 大家的回答各不相同，不过正如你所说，这一切都与错位的自信有关。

cues.en: It is, and it's not the first time we've seen that.
cues.zh: 是的，而且这并不是我们第一次看到这种情况。

cues.en: So there have been other studies where men in particular report feeling confident in their ability to do arguably quite difficult tasks.
cues.zh: 还有其他研究显示，尤其是男性，会声称自己有信心完成一些可以说相当困难的任务。

cues.en: In the US, in 2021, there was a study that found that 22% of men surveyed thought they could beat a chimpanzee in a fight.
cues.zh: 2021 年，美国一项研究发现，22% 的男性受访者认为自己能在搏斗中打败黑猩猩。

cues.en: Another one that you might remember, it went quite viral in 2023.
cues.zh: 你可能还记得另一项研究，它在 2023 年一度广为流传。

cues.en: It found that half of men surveyed in the US said they could land a commercial plane in an emergency.
cues.zh: 该研究发现，一半的美国男性受访者表示，紧急情况下自己能让一架民航客机着陆。

cues.en: A quick point worth noting: a British team that looked into gender differences in estimating ability—that was last year—
cues.zh: 还有一点值得一提：去年，一个英国团队研究了能力自我评估中的性别差异——

cues.en: it did find that men tend to overestimate themselves, but women tended to underestimate.
cues.zh: 研究确实发现，男性往往会高估自己，而女性则往往会低估自己。

cues.en: So there could be something to be said for having a bit more confidence sometimes, though maybe not.
cues.zh: 所以有时候多一点自信也许确实有些道理，不过也未必。

cues.en: We can argue, when it comes to fighting a chimpanzee.
cues.zh: 至少说到和黑猩猩搏斗时，这一点还有待商榷。

cues.en: Stephanie Prentice.
cues.zh: 斯蒂芬妮·普伦蒂斯报道。

cues.en: And that is all from us for now.
cues.zh: 以上就是本期节目的全部内容。

cues.en: But the Global News Podcast will be back very soon.
cues.zh: 《全球新闻播客》很快会再与大家见面。

cues.en: This edition was mixed by Paul Mason.
cues.zh: 本期节目由保罗·梅森完成混音。

cues.en: Our editor is Karen Martin.
cues.zh: 编辑是凯伦·马丁。

cues.en: I'm Oliver Conway.
cues.zh: 我是奥利弗·康韦。

cues.en: Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 下次再会。
